```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 11,
  fig.height = 6.5,
  dpi = 120
)

# Keep the UTF-8 column names intact when the RDS is read on Windows.
try(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "English_United States.utf8"), silent = TRUE)

required_packages <- c("dplyr", "ggplot2", "pROC")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages)) {
  stop("Install the following packages before knitting: ",
       paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

source_file <- "cohorte_retrascore.rds"
if (!file.exists(source_file)) {
  stop("cohorte_retrascore.rds was not found in the working directory.")
}

cohort <- readRDS(source_file)
output_dir <- "outputs_retrascore_2020_2025_validation"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Normalize the year field because its UTF-8 name can be displayed differently
# by different Windows locales.
ascii_names <- tolower(iconv(
  names(cohort), from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT"
))
year_index <- which(ascii_names == "ano_trauma")
if (length(year_index) != 1L) {
  stop("The trauma-year column could not be identified uniquely.")
}
names(cohort)[year_index] <- "ano_trauma"
```

# Aim and validation design

The original RETRASCORE is applied without re-estimating any coefficient. The
historical cohort contains patients from 2015-2019, the period used in the
article, and the new temporal cohort contains patients from 2020 onward. Only
years no later than the year in which this report is run are accepted; this
excludes impossible future dates.

The outcome is 30-day mortality. A score and predicted probability are
calculated only when all 13 RETRASCORE predictors are available. Validation
metrics additionally require a known 30-day outcome. No missing values are
imputed.

The published logistic equation is used for predicted mortality. The integer
score is calculated as described in the article: each shrunken regression
coefficient is multiplied by two and rounded to the nearest integer. Published
risk categories are also assigned to every patient with a calculable score.

```{r published-score-table, echo=FALSE}
published_points <- data.frame(
  Predictor = c(
    "Age <50", "Age 50-65", "Age 66-75", "Age >75", "PRECOAG",
    "Pre-hospital intubation", "High-risk mechanism", "Normal pupils",
    "Unilateral mydriasis", "Bilateral mydriasis", "GCS <=8",
    "MAIS head", "MAIS thorax", "Haemodynamic failure",
    "Respiratory failure", "Coagulopathy at 24 h",
    "Mechanical ventilation", "Massive haemorrhage"
  ),
  Coefficient = c(
    0, 0.598, 1.239, 2.198, 0.349, 0.336, 0.662, 0, 0.950,
    3.217, 0.841, 0.495, -0.271, 1.148, 0.708, 0.567, 0.580, 0.452
  ),
  Points = c(0, 1, 2, 4, 1, 1, 1, 0, 2, 6, 2, 1, -1, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(
  published_points,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Published RETRASCORE coefficients and integer points"
)
```

# Data checks and cohort definition

```{r data-checks}
model_variables <- c(
  "edad_categoria", "precoag", "iot_prehospitalaria",
  "mecanismo_alto_riesgo", "pupilas", "gcs_menor_igual_8",
  "mais_cabeza", "mais_torax", "fallo_hemodinamico",
  "fallo_respiratorio", "coagulopatia_24h",
  "ventilacion_mecanica", "hemorragia_masiva"
)
required_variables <- c("ano_trauma", "mortalidad_30d", model_variables)
missing_variables <- setdiff(required_variables, names(cohort))
if (length(missing_variables)) {
  stop("Missing required variables: ", paste(missing_variables, collapse = ", "))
}

check_binary <- function(x, variable_name) {
  observed <- unique(stats::na.omit(x))
  if (!all(observed %in% c(0, 1))) {
    stop("Variable '", variable_name, "' contains values other than 0, 1 or NA.")
  }
  as.integer(x)
}

binary_variables <- setdiff(
  model_variables,
  c("edad_categoria", "pupilas")
)
for (variable_name in binary_variables) {
  cohort[[variable_name]] <- check_binary(
    cohort[[variable_name]], variable_name
  )
}
cohort$mortalidad_30d <- check_binary(
  cohort$mortalidad_30d, "mortalidad_30d"
)

valid_age_levels <- c("<50", "50-65", "66-75", ">75")
unexpected_age <- setdiff(
  unique(stats::na.omit(as.character(cohort$edad_categoria))),
  valid_age_levels
)
if (length(unexpected_age)) {
  stop("Unexpected age categories: ", paste(unexpected_age, collapse = ", "))
}

valid_pupil_levels <- c(
  "normal", "midriasis unilateral", "midriasis bilateral"
)
unexpected_pupils <- setdiff(
  unique(stats::na.omit(as.character(cohort$pupilas))),
  valid_pupil_levels
)
if (length(unexpected_pupils)) {
  stop("Unexpected pupil categories: ", paste(unexpected_pupils, collapse = ", "))
}

current_year <- as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
future_years <- sort(unique(cohort$ano_trauma[
  !is.na(cohort$ano_trauma) & cohort$ano_trauma > current_year
]))

analysis_cohort <- cohort %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ano_trauma),
    ano_trauma >= 2015,
    ano_trauma <= current_year
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      ano_trauma >= 2015 & ano_trauma <= 2019 ~ "2015-2019",
      ano_trauma >= 2020 ~ "2020 onward",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("2015-2019", "2020 onward"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(period))

if (!nrow(analysis_cohort)) stop("No patients met the date criteria.")
if (any(table(analysis_cohort$period) == 0)) {
  stop("At least one comparison period has no patients.")
}

latest_new_year <- max(
  analysis_cohort$ano_trauma[analysis_cohort$period == "2020 onward"]
)
levels(analysis_cohort$period) <- c(
  "2015-2019", paste0("2020-", latest_new_year)
)
period_labels <- levels(analysis_cohort$period)
```

```{r cohort-flow, echo=FALSE}
flow_table <- analysis_cohort %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    Patients = n(),
    `Known 30-day outcome` = sum(!is.na(mortalidad_30d)),
    `Complete RETRASCORE predictors` = sum(
      complete.cases(across(all_of(model_variables)))
    ),
    `Complete predictors and outcome` = sum(
      complete.cases(across(all_of(c(model_variables, "mortalidad_30d"))))
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

date_audit <- data.frame(
  Item = c(
    "Rows in source RDS",
    "Rows in the two requested periods",
    "Latest included year",
    "Future/impossible years excluded"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(cohort),
    nrow(analysis_cohort),
    latest_new_year,
    if (length(future_years)) paste(future_years, collapse = ", ") else "None"
  )
)

knitr::kable(date_audit, caption = "Date audit")
knitr::kable(flow_table, caption = "Cohort flow and complete-case denominators")
```

# Patient-level RETRASCORE

```{r calculate-retrascore}
age <- as.character(analysis_cohort$edad_categoria)
pupils <- as.character(analysis_cohort$pupilas)

score_components <- data.frame(
  age = unname(c("<50" = 0L, "50-65" = 1L, "66-75" = 2L, ">75" = 4L)[age]),
  precoag = analysis_cohort$precoag,
  prehospital_intubation = analysis_cohort$iot_prehospitalaria,
  high_risk_mechanism = analysis_cohort$mecanismo_alto_riesgo,
  pupils = unname(c(
    "normal" = 0L,
    "midriasis unilateral" = 2L,
    "midriasis bilateral" = 6L
  )[pupils]),
  gcs_le_8 = 2L * analysis_cohort$gcs_menor_igual_8,
  mais_head = analysis_cohort$mais_cabeza,
  mais_thorax = -analysis_cohort$mais_torax,
  haemodynamic_failure = 2L * analysis_cohort$fallo_hemodinamico,
  respiratory_failure = analysis_cohort$fallo_respiratorio,
  coagulopathy = analysis_cohort$coagulopatia_24h,
  mechanical_ventilation = analysis_cohort$ventilacion_mecanica,
  massive_haemorrhage = analysis_cohort$hemorragia_masiva
)

score_available <- complete.cases(score_components)
analysis_cohort$retrascore <- NA_integer_
analysis_cohort$retrascore[score_available] <- rowSums(
  score_components[score_available, , drop = FALSE]
)

linear_predictor <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(analysis_cohort))
linear_predictor[score_available] <- with(
  analysis_cohort[score_available, , drop = FALSE],
  -5.432 +
    0.598 * (edad_categoria == "50-65") +
    1.239 * (edad_categoria == "66-75") +
    2.198 * (edad_categoria == ">75") +
    0.349 * precoag +
    0.336 * iot_prehospitalaria +
    0.662 * mecanismo_alto_riesgo +
    0.950 * (pupilas == "midriasis unilateral") +
    3.217 * (pupilas == "midriasis bilateral") +
    0.841 * gcs_menor_igual_8 +
    0.495 * mais_cabeza -
    0.271 * mais_torax +
    1.148 * fallo_hemodinamico +
    0.708 * fallo_respiratorio +
    0.567 * coagulopatia_24h +
    0.580 * ventilacion_mecanica +
    0.452 * hemorragia_masiva
)
analysis_cohort$predicted_mortality <- plogis(linear_predictor)

risk_levels <- c(
  "Very low (<5)", "Low (5-6)", "Medium (7-8)",
  "High (9-11)", "Very high (12-13)", "Extreme (14+)"
)
analysis_cohort$risk_group <- cut(
  analysis_cohort$retrascore,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 4, 6, 8, 11, 13, Inf),
  labels = risk_levels,
  ordered_result = TRUE
)
analysis_cohort$score_display_group <- ifelse(
  is.na(analysis_cohort$retrascore),
  NA_character_,
  ifelse(
    analysis_cohort$retrascore >= 14,
    "14+",
    as.character(analysis_cohort$retrascore)
  )
)

# Preserve identifiers when present, but do not require a particular identifier.
identifier_candidates <- c("id_fila", "historia", "registro", "hospital")
identifier_variables <- intersect(identifier_candidates, names(analysis_cohort))
patient_results <- analysis_cohort %>%
  select(
    all_of(identifier_variables), ano_trauma, period, mortalidad_30d,
    all_of(model_variables), retrascore, score_display_group, risk_group,
    predicted_mortality
  )

utils::write.csv(
  patient_results,
  file.path(output_dir, "retrascore_patient_scores.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = "",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

stopifnot(
  all(is.na(analysis_cohort$retrascore) == !score_available),
  all(analysis_cohort$predicted_mortality[score_available] >= 0),
  all(analysis_cohort$predicted_mortality[score_available] <= 1)
)
```

The file `outputs_retrascore_2020_2025_validation/retrascore_patient_scores.csv`
contains the RETRASCORE, published risk group, and predicted probability for
every patient in both periods. Rows with an incomplete score retain `NA`, so
missing data are explicit rather than silently treated as zero.

```{r patient-score-summary, echo=FALSE}
score_summary <- analysis_cohort %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    Patients = n(),
    `Score calculated` = sum(!is.na(retrascore)),
    `Score missing` = sum(is.na(retrascore)),
    `Minimum score` = min(retrascore, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Median score` = median(retrascore, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Maximum score` = max(retrascore, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
knitr::kable(score_summary, caption = "Patient-level score availability")
```

# Validation of the published equation

The primary validation uses the continuous predicted probability, not a
re-fitted model or an arbitrary classification threshold. Discrimination is
summarised by AUROC with a DeLong 95% confidence interval; overall accuracy by
the Brier score; and calibration by mean predicted versus observed mortality,
observed-to-expected deaths, calibration intercept, and calibration slope.

```{r validation-metrics}
evaluate_period <- function(data, period_name) {
  evaluable <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(mortalidad_30d), !is.na(predicted_mortality))
  if (length(unique(evaluable$mortalidad_30d)) != 2L) {
    stop("Both outcome classes are required in ", period_name, ".")
  }

  roc_object <- pROC::roc(
    response = evaluable$mortalidad_30d,
    predictor = evaluable$predicted_mortality,
    levels = c(0, 1),
    direction = "<",
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  auc_ci <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(roc_object, method = "delong"))
  lp <- qlogis(pmin(pmax(evaluable$predicted_mortality, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12))
  calibration_intercept_model <- glm(
    evaluable$mortalidad_30d ~ 1,
    offset = lp,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
  calibration_slope_model <- glm(
    evaluable$mortalidad_30d ~ lp,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )

  data.frame(
    Period = period_name,
    N = nrow(evaluable),
    Deaths = sum(evaluable$mortalidad_30d),
    `Observed mortality (%)` = 100 * mean(evaluable$mortalidad_30d),
    `Predicted mortality (%)` = 100 * mean(evaluable$predicted_mortality),
    `Observed/expected deaths` = sum(evaluable$mortalidad_30d) /
      sum(evaluable$predicted_mortality),
    AUROC = as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_object)),
    `AUROC 95% CI lower` = auc_ci[1],
    `AUROC 95% CI upper` = auc_ci[3],
    Brier = mean(
      (evaluable$mortalidad_30d - evaluable$predicted_mortality)^2
    ),
    `Calibration intercept` = unname(coef(calibration_intercept_model)[1]),
    `Calibration slope` = unname(coef(calibration_slope_model)[2]),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

validation_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(period_labels, function(period_name) {
    evaluate_period(
      analysis_cohort[analysis_cohort$period == period_name, , drop = FALSE],
      period_name
    )
  })
)
row.names(validation_results) <- NULL

utils::write.csv(
  validation_results,
  file.path(output_dir, "retrascore_validation_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

validation_display <- validation_results
validation_display$`AUROC (95% CI)` <- sprintf(
  "%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
  validation_display$AUROC,
  validation_display$`AUROC 95% CI lower`,
  validation_display$`AUROC 95% CI upper`
)
validation_display <- validation_display[, c(
  "Period", "N", "Deaths", "Observed mortality (%)",
  "Predicted mortality (%)", "Observed/expected deaths",
  "AUROC (95% CI)", "Brier", "Calibration intercept",
  "Calibration slope"
)]

knitr::kable(
  validation_display,
  digits = c(0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 3, 0, 3, 3, 3),
  caption = "Validation of the unchanged published RETRASCORE equation"
)
```

For calibration, ideal values are an observed-to-expected ratio of 1, an
intercept of 0, and a slope of 1. Lower Brier scores are better. These measures
should be interpreted together with the cohort size and number of deaths.

## Calibration by risk decile

```{r calibration-deciles}
calibration_deciles <- analysis_cohort %>%
  filter(!is.na(mortalidad_30d), !is.na(predicted_mortality)) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  mutate(risk_decile = dplyr::ntile(predicted_mortality, 10)) %>%
  group_by(period, risk_decile) %>%
  summarise(
    Patients = n(),
    predicted = mean(predicted_mortality),
    observed = mean(mortalidad_30d),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

calibration_plot <- ggplot(
  calibration_deciles,
  aes(x = predicted * 100, y = observed * 100)
) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey45") +
  geom_line(colour = "#1B6CA8", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Patients), colour = "#1B6CA8", alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ period) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  labs(
    title = "Calibration of the published RETRASCORE equation",
    subtitle = "Observed versus predicted 30-day mortality by risk decile",
    x = "Mean predicted mortality (%)",
    y = "Observed mortality (%)",
    size = "Patients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

calibration_plot

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "retrascore_calibration_by_decile.png"),
  calibration_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 180
)
```

# Mortality by RETRASCORE group

Exact binomial 95% confidence intervals are shown around the observed
mortality. The denominator is the number of scored patients with a known
30-day outcome in each group.

```{r mortality-by-risk-group}
summarise_mortality <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(mortalidad_30d), !is.na(risk_group)) %>%
    group_by(period, risk_group, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(
      Patients = n(),
      Deaths = sum(mortalidad_30d),
      `Observed mortality (%)` = 100 * mean(mortalidad_30d),
      `Predicted mortality (%)` = 100 * mean(predicted_mortality),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      `95% CI lower` = if (Patients > 0) {
        100 * stats::binom.test(Deaths, Patients)$conf.int[1]
      } else NA_real_,
      `95% CI upper` = if (Patients > 0) {
        100 * stats::binom.test(Deaths, Patients)$conf.int[2]
      } else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

mortality_by_group <- summarise_mortality(analysis_cohort)

utils::write.csv(
  mortality_by_group,
  file.path(output_dir, "mortality_by_retrascore_risk_group.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

knitr::kable(
  mortality_by_group,
  digits = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 2, 2),
  caption = "Observed and predicted mortality by published RETRASCORE risk group"
)
```

```{r plot-mortality-groups, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Observed 30-day mortality by published RETRASCORE risk group and period."}
ggsave(
```

## Predicted versus observed mortality in 2020-2025

This plot directly compares the mean mortality predicted by the unchanged
published equation with the observed 30-day mortality in each RETRASCORE risk
group in the new temporal cohort. Error bars around observed mortality are
exact binomial 95% confidence intervals; predicted mortality is a model
estimate and is therefore shown without those outcome-based intervals.

```{r predicted-versus-observed-2020-2025, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Predicted and observed 30-day mortality by RETRASCORE risk group in 2020-2025."}
new_period_name <- period_labels[2]
mortality_new_period <- mortality_by_group %>%
  filter(period == new_period_name) %>%
  select(
    risk_group, Patients, Deaths,
    `Observed mortality (%)`, `Predicted mortality (%)`,
    `95% CI lower`, `95% CI upper`
  )

plot_data_new_period <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    risk_group = mortality_new_period$risk_group,
    Patients = mortality_new_period$Patients,
    mortality_type = "Observed",
    mortality_pct = mortality_new_period$`Observed mortality (%)`,
    ci_lower = mortality_new_period$`95% CI lower`,
    ci_upper = mortality_new_period$`95% CI upper`
  ),
  data.frame(
    risk_group = mortality_new_period$risk_group,
    Patients = mortality_new_period$Patients,
    mortality_type = "Predicted",
    mortality_pct = mortality_new_period$`Predicted mortality (%)`,
    ci_lower = NA_real_,
    ci_upper = NA_real_
  )
)
plot_data_new_period$mortality_type <- factor(
  plot_data_new_period$mortality_type,
  levels = c("Predicted", "Observed")
)

dodge_new_period <- position_dodge(width = 0.82)
predicted_observed_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_data_new_period,
  aes(x = risk_group, y = mortality_pct, fill = mortality_type)
) +
  geom_col(position = dodge_new_period, width = 0.76, colour = "white") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
    position = dodge_new_period,
    width = 0.20,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", mortality_pct)),
    position = dodge_new_period,
    vjust = -0.45,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Predicted" = "#756BB1", "Observed" = "#E6550D")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 105),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Predicted versus observed mortality, ", new_period_name),
    subtitle = "Comparison within the published RETRASCORE risk groups",
    x = "Published RETRASCORE risk group",
    y = "30-day mortality (%)",
    fill = "Mortality"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

predicted_observed_plot

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "predicted_vs_observed_mortality_2020_2025.png"),
  predicted_observed_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 180
)
```

## Mortality by exact RETRASCORE points

As in the article, scores above 13 are pooled because individual high scores
contain few patients.

```{r plot-mortality-exact-score}
score_levels_below_14 <- sort(unique(
  analysis_cohort$retrascore[
    !is.na(analysis_cohort$retrascore) & analysis_cohort$retrascore < 14
  ]
))
score_levels <- c(as.character(score_levels_below_14), "14+")
analysis_cohort$score_display_group <- factor(
  analysis_cohort$score_display_group,
  levels = score_levels,
  ordered = TRUE
)

mortality_by_score <- analysis_cohort %>%
  filter(!is.na(mortalidad_30d), !is.na(score_display_group)) %>%
  group_by(period, score_display_group, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(
    Patients = n(),
    Deaths = sum(mortalidad_30d),
    mortality_pct = 100 * mean(mortalidad_30d),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(Patients > 0)

utils::write.csv(
  mortality_by_score,
  file.path(output_dir, "mortality_by_exact_retrascore.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

mortality_score_plot <- ggplot(
  mortality_by_score,
  aes(
    x = score_display_group,
    y = mortality_pct,
    colour = period,
    group = period
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Patients), alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#377EB8", "#E6550D")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed mortality by RETRASCORE points",
    subtitle = "Scores of 14 or more are grouped as 14+",
    x = "RETRASCORE points",
    y = "Observed 30-day mortality (%)",
    colour = "Cohort",
    size = "Patients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 12)),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

mortality_score_plot

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "mortality_by_exact_retrascore.png"),
  mortality_score_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 180
)
```

# Reproducibility notes

- The published coefficients, intercept, integer points, and risk categories
  are applied unchanged in both cohorts.
- The new cohort begins in 2020 and ends at the last non-future year available
  in the RDS (`r latest_new_year`).
- The historical comparison uses all patients from 2015-2019; it is not split
  again into the article's derivation and internal-validation subsets because
  the requested comparison is between eras.
- Missing predictors are not imputed and are not assigned zero points.
- Mortality percentages use only patients with a known 30-day outcome.
- Scores of 14 or more are combined in the exact-score graph, matching the
  article's handling of sparse high scores.

# Source

Servia L, et al. *Development of a new score for early mortality prediction in
trauma ICU patients: RETRASCORE*. Critical Care. 2021;25:420.
doi:10.1186/s13054-021-03845-6.

```{r session-info}
sessionInfo()
```

# Cohort-specific coefficients, RETRASCORE points, odds ratios and confidence intervals

The following two models use the same 13 RETRASCORE predictors but are fitted
separately in the historical derivation cohort and the temporal validation
cohort. RETRASCORE points are calculated as in the original score
(`round(2 x beta)`). The 95% confidence interval shown is the Wald interval for
the odds ratio. Reference categories have beta 0, zero points and OR 1 by
definition, so an independent confidence interval is not applicable. The
validation-cohort refit is descriptive and does not replace the primary
validation of the unchanged published equation reported above.

```{r cohort-specific-coefficient-tables, echo=FALSE}
cohort_model_formula <- mortalidad_30d ~
  edad_categoria +
  precoag +
  iot_prehospitalaria +
  mecanismo_alto_riesgo +
  pupilas +
  gcs_menor_igual_8 +
  mais_cabeza +
  mais_torax +
  fallo_hemodinamico +
  fallo_respiratorio +
  coagulopatia_24h +
  ventilacion_mecanica +
  hemorragia_masiva

coefficient_labels <- c(
  "edad_categoria<50" = "Age <50 (reference)",
  "edad_categoria50-65" = "Age 50-65",
  "edad_categoria66-75" = "Age 66-75",
  "edad_categoria>75" = "Age >75",
  "precoag" = "PRECOAG",
  "iot_prehospitalaria" = "Pre-hospital intubation",
  "mecanismo_alto_riesgo" = "High-risk mechanism",
  "pupilasnormal" = "Normal pupils (reference)",
  "pupilasmidriasis unilateral" = "Unilateral mydriasis",
  "pupilasmidriasis bilateral" = "Bilateral mydriasis",
  "gcs_menor_igual_8" = "GCS <=8",
  "mais_cabeza" = "MAIS head",
  "mais_torax" = "MAIS thorax",
  "fallo_hemodinamico" = "Haemodynamic failure",
  "fallo_respiratorio" = "Respiratory failure",
  "coagulopatia_24h" = "Coagulopathy at 24 h",
  "ventilacion_mecanica" = "Mechanical ventilation",
  "hemorragia_masiva" = "Massive haemorrhage"
)

fit_cohort_coefficient_table <- function(data, cohort_name) {
  model_data <- data %>%
    select(mortalidad_30d, all_of(model_variables)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
    mutate(
      edad_categoria = factor(
        as.character(edad_categoria), levels = valid_age_levels
      ),
      pupilas = factor(as.character(pupilas), levels = valid_pupil_levels)
    )

  if (nrow(model_data) == 0L || length(unique(model_data$mortalidad_30d)) != 2L) {
    stop("The ", cohort_name,
         " cohort does not contain enough complete data to fit the model.")
  }

  fitted_model <- glm(
    cohort_model_formula,
    data = model_data,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
  if (!fitted_model$converged || anyNA(coef(fitted_model))) {
    stop("The cohort-specific model could not be estimated for ", cohort_name,
         ".")
  }

  coefficient_matrix <- summary(fitted_model)$coefficients
  coefficient_matrix <- coefficient_matrix[
    rownames(coefficient_matrix) != "(Intercept)", , drop = FALSE
  ]
  result <- data.frame(
    term = rownames(coefficient_matrix),
    Beta = coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"],
    `RETRASCORE points` = as.integer(round(
      2 * coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"]
    )),
    OR = exp(coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"]),
    CI_lower = exp(
      coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"] -
        1.96 * coefficient_matrix[, "Std. Error"]
    ),
    CI_upper = exp(
      coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"] +
        1.96 * coefficient_matrix[, "Std. Error"]
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  reference_rows <- data.frame(
    term = c("edad_categoria<50", "pupilasnormal"),
    Beta = 0,
    `RETRASCORE points` = 0L,
    OR = 1,
    CI_lower = NA_real_,
    CI_upper = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  result <- rbind(result, reference_rows)
  result <- result[match(names(coefficient_labels), result$term), , drop = FALSE]
  result$Variable <- unname(coefficient_labels[result$term])
  result$`OR (95% CI)` <- ifelse(
    is.na(result$CI_lower),
    "Reference",
    sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)", result$OR, result$CI_lower, result$CI_upper)
  )
  result <- result[, c(
    "Variable", "Beta", "RETRASCORE points", "OR", "OR (95% CI)"
  )]

  list(model = fitted_model, n = nrow(model_data), table = result)
}

derivation_fit <- fit_cohort_coefficient_table(
  analysis_cohort %>% filter(period == period_labels[1]),
  period_labels[1]
)
validation_fit <- fit_cohort_coefficient_table(
  analysis_cohort %>% filter(period == period_labels[2]),
  period_labels[2]
)

write.csv(
  derivation_fit$table,
  file.path(output_dir, "retrascore_coefficients_derivation.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
write.csv(
  validation_fit$table,
  file.path(output_dir, "retrascore_coefficients_validation.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

knitr::kable(
  derivation_fit$table,
  digits = c(NA, 3, 0, 3, NA),
  caption = paste0(
    "Cohort-specific RETRASCORE model: derivation ", period_labels[1],
    " (complete cases N=", derivation_fit$n, ")"
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  validation_fit$table,
  digits = c(NA, 3, 0, 3, NA),
  caption = paste0(
    "Cohort-specific RETRASCORE model: validation ", period_labels[2],
    " (complete cases N=", validation_fit$n, ")"
  )
)
```
